test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 25 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The cost price of an article is Rs.6,450. If it sold at a profit 16%, how much would be its selling price?
solution:
Given:

Cost price = Rs.6, 450

Profit = 16%

Concept:

Selling price = ((100+profit))/(100)×Cost space price

Calculation:

Selling price = ((100+16))/(100)×6, 450

⇒ (116/100) × 6450

⇒ 58 ×129

∴ The Selling price is Rs. 7482​.
